title: AgentAM: An AI Agent for Spatter- and Defect-Aware Process Optimization in Laser Powder Bed Fusion
summary: For SS316L laser powder bed fusion, simulation-trained surrogates and constrained optimization identify a trade-off between predicted spatter and defect margins. Cross-validation evaluates simulation predictions; no physical process validation is reported.
ai_technology: CFD-trained polynomial response-surface surrogates; AgentAM LLM agent
